data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The 1/9 loss is not a property of compile.py's code but of its position as the first module in the installation order; any module placed first under shown-to-fail-first installation would lose the same proportion of mutations, so the test constrains only when the installation order makes the subject's failure visible before the test runs.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a different module placed first would lose a different proportion of mutations","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1/9 loss were reproduced with compile.py placed later in the installation order","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 result showed no correlation with installation position","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The installation order is a linear sequence, and the first module is the only one whose failures are committed before any guard is installed.
